# Sabnock Works

> Sabnock Works is an independent game studio creating dark fantasy dungeon crawlers, historical strategy games, free d20 tabletop material, essays, and fiction.

Canonical site: https://sabnockworks.com/
Language: English
Publisher: Sabnock Works, Germany

## Games

- [Sabnock Works](https://sabnockworks.com/): Studio overview featuring Lathmar: The Fallen Depths, War of the Wizards, Routes of Africa, Velvet Cruise and Lathmar: Emerald Hollows.
- [Lathmar: The Fallen Depths](https://lathmar.de/): A dark fantasy dungeon crawler inspired by classic 1990s roleplaying games.
- [War of the Wizards](https://sabnockworks.com/games/war-of-the-wizards/): Turn-based fantasy tactics inspired by Julian Gollop's Chaos, with 73 spells, creature summoning and illusion bluffs. Play the full browser version free while in development; feedback appreciated. A separate Windows demo and gameplay videos are also available.
- [Routes of Africa](https://sabnockworks.com/games/routes-of-africa/): A historical expedition strategy game about exploration, route planning, documentation, and resource management in 19th-century North and Central Africa.
- [Velvet Cruise](https://sabnockworks.com/games/velvet-cruise/): Game information, screenshots, controls and a Play the Game link for the pixel-art arcade driving game. Fifteen branching stages and five finish lines. Free to play while in development.
- [Play Velvet Cruise](https://sabnockworks.com/games/more-projects/velvet-cruise/): The existing playable browser edition, with keyboard and touch controls and scores and badges saved in the browser.

- [Lathmar: Emerald Hollows](https://sabnockworks.com/games/emerald-hollows/): Game information, controls and a Play the Game link for the cave action-puzzle game. Fifty caves, keyboard and touch controls, and English and German text. Free to play while in development.
- [Play Lathmar: Emerald Hollows](https://sabnockworks.com/games/more-projects/emerald-hollows/): The existing playable browser edition.
- [More Projects archive](https://sabnockworks.com/games/more-projects/): The earlier combined game page, retained with its section links for existing external posts. Current homepage navigation uses the individual game information pages above.

## Tabletop Roleplaying Material

- [Free d20 adventures and dungeon material](https://sabnockworks.com/tabletop/): Fifth-edition-compatible mythic weapons plus dungeon campaign material for d20 and Lathmar, including the Ancient Mega-Dungeons collection.

## Essays

- [Essays archive](https://sabnockworks.com/articles/): Long-form writing on mythology, legendary weapons, ancient mega-dungeons, game design, and storytelling.
- [Mythic Spears](https://sabnockworks.com/articles/mythic-spears/): Six essays by Michael Kahler about mythology, power, sacrifice, and legendary weapons.
- [Ancient Mega Dungeons](https://sabnockworks.com/articles/ancient-mega-dungeons/): Complete illustrated reading edition of five essays on ancient labyrinths, sacred mountains, underground cities and sealed tombs, with sources and lessons for RPG design. PDF download available.
- [Heinrich Barth: The Scholar Who Crossed Kingdoms](https://sabnockworks.com/articles/heinrich-barth/): Complete reading edition about Barth's life, journeys, collaborators and legacy, and the historical foundations of Routes of Africa. PDF download available.

## Dark Fantasy Fiction

- [Stories archive](https://sabnockworks.com/stories/): Free dark fantasy stories and novellas from the fallen world of Lathmar.
- [The Tithe of Small Despairs](https://sabnockworks.com/stories/tithe-of-small-despairs/): A dark fantasy story by Michael Kahler.
- [The Rat King](https://sabnockworks.com/stories/the-rat-king/): A dark fantasy novella by Michael Kahler.
- [The Price of a Crown](https://sabnockworks.com/stories/the-price-of-a-crown/): A dark fantasy novella by Michael Kahler.
